about_zh: 字体、图标、配色、设计系统这些视觉基础件。

repos.description: A collection of DESIGN.md files analysis by popular brand design systems. Drop one into your project and let coding agents generate a matching UI.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome DESIGN.md 是一个精选的 DESIGN.md 文件集合，源自主流网站的设计系统。每个文件包含完整的视觉主题、色彩体系、排版规则、组件样式和响应式规范，AI 编码代理可直接读取生成像素级匹配的 UI。支持明暗模式预览，适用于快速复刻知名产品界面。
repos.summary_en: Awesome DESIGN.md is a curated collection of design system files from popular websites, each following Google Stitch's plain-text format. It includes visual themes, color palettes, typography rules, component styles, and responsive behavior, enabling AI coding agents to generate pixel-perfect UIs directly from markdown without Figma or JSON dependencies.

repos.description: Free monospaced font with programming ligatures
repos.summary_zh: Fira Code 是一款专为程序员设计的免费等宽字体，支持编程连字（ligatures），可自动将常见符号组合（如 `->`、`<=`、`:=`）渲染为单一视觉单元，提升代码可读性。字体完全兼容 ASCII，保留源码结构，同时提供丰富的字形变体、样式集和 Unicode 支持，适用于编辑器、终端及数学公式显示。
repos.summary_en: Fira Code is a free monospaced font featuring programming ligatures that render multi-character sequences like `->` or `:=` as single glyphs, enhancing code readability. It maintains ASCII compatibility while offering stylistic sets, character variants, and full Unicode support for editors, terminals, and mathematical notation.

repos.description: Maple Mono: Open source monospace font with round corner, ligatures and Nerd-Font icons for IDE and terminal, fine-grained customization options. 带连字和控制台图标的圆角等宽字体，中英文宽度完美2:1，细粒度的自定义选项
repos.summary_zh: Maple Mono 是一款专为提升编码体验而设计的开源等宽字体，具有圆角设计、连字功能及 Nerd-Font 图标支持，适用于 IDE 和终端环境。其特色包括可变字重、智能连字、中英文 2:1 完美对齐，以及细粒度自定义选项，支持简繁中文和日文，适合多语言开发场景。
repos.summary_en: Maple Mono is an open-source monospace font designed to enhance coding flow, featuring rounded corners, ligatures, and Nerd-Font icons for IDEs and terminals. It offers variable font weights, smart ligatures, perfect 2:1 Chinese-English alignment, and extensive customization, supporting Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese for multilingual development environments.

repos.description: An open-source Chinese font derived from Fontworks' Klee One. 一款开源中文字体，基于 FONTWORKS 出品字体 Klee One 衍生。
repos.summary_zh: 霞鹜文楷是一款基于 FONTWORKS Klee One 衍生的开源中文字体，采用 OFL 1.1 协议授权，支持免费商用。提供多个变体版本，包括屏幕阅读版、轻便版、GB 规范版及繁体旧字形版，适配不同场景需求。
repos.summary_en: LXGW WenKai is an open-source Chinese font derived from Fontworks' Klee One, licensed under OFL 1.1 for free commercial use. It offers multiple variants including screen-optimized, lite, GB-compliant, and traditional character editions for diverse applications.

repos.description: Vira Theme is the official successor of the popular Material Theme. This premium version is actively maintained, includes hand-curated icons and more features
repos.summary_zh: Vira Theme 是 Material Theme 的官方继任者，为 VS Code 提供现代化主题与图标套件，包含六种精心设计的深色主题（如 Teal、Ocean、Carbon），支持高度定制与持续更新，专为开发者打造视觉沉浸的编码环境。
repos.summary_en: Vira Theme is the premium successor to Material Theme for VS Code, offering six hand-curated dark themes and icons with enhanced customization, modern aesthetics, and continuous updates for an immersive developer experience.

repos.description: Vira Theme is the official successor of the popular Material Theme. This premium version is actively maintained, includes hand-curated icons and more features
repos.summary_zh: Vira Theme 是热门 Material Theme 的官方升级版本，作为高端主题持续维护，提供精心策划的图标库及增强功能，适用于现代化 UI 设计与开发。
repos.summary_en: Vira Theme is the premium successor to the popular Material Theme, actively maintained with hand-curated icons and enhanced features for modern UI design and development.

repos.description: Vira Theme is the official successor of the popular Material Theme. This premium version is actively maintained, includes hand-curated icons and more features
repos.summary_zh: Vira Theme 是广受欢迎的 Material Theme 的官方继任者，提供精心设计的图标和丰富功能。该仓库为 Vira Software 的公共资源库，包含主题资产及设计工具相关素材，支持设计系统一致性与高效开发。
repos.summary_en: Vira Theme is the official successor to the popular Material Theme, offering curated icons and enhanced features. This repository hosts public assets for Vira Software, including theme resources and design tools, supporting consistent design systems and efficient development.

repos.description: A free + OSS logo generator powered by Flux on Together AI
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Flux 大模型的开源 AI Logo 生成器，集成 Together AI 实现秒级品牌级 Logo 设计。支持 SVG/PNG 多格式导出、参考图上传解析及完整品牌套件输出，零账户门槛使用，适用于快速品牌设计与创意原型制作。
repos.summary_en: An open-source AI logo generator powered by Flux and Together AI, delivering production-ready brand logos in seconds. Features include SVG/PNG export, reference image upload via vision models, and complete brand kit generation. No account required, ideal for rapid brand design and creative prototyping.

repos.summary_zh: 专业SVG Logo生成器，基于产品特性生成6+设计变体，结合12种高端背景风格创建展示图。支持Gemini 3.1 Flash图像预览生成高品质效果图，提供可编辑SVG与即用PNG格式，适用于初创公司、开发者和设计团队快速打造品牌标识。
repos.summary_en: Professional SVG logo generator creating 6+ design variants with 12 curated background styles for high-end showcases. Leverages Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview to produce studio-quality presentation images, offering editable SVG and ready-to-use PNG formats for startups, developers, and design teams.

repos.description: Skill and MCP server for searching and retrieving icons
repos.summary_zh: Better Icons 是一个图标搜索与检索工具，提供20万+图标资源，支持150+主流图标库（如 Lucide、Heroicons）。可作为 MCP 服务器集成到 AI 编程助手（Cursor/Claude等），或作为 CLI 工具直接调用。具备智能学习、批量获取、跨框架导出等功能，显著提升开发者在 AI 辅助编码中的图标使用效率。
repos.summary_en: Better Icons is a skill and MCP server for searching and retrieving over 200,000 icons from 150+ collections (e.g., Lucide, Heroicons). It integrates with AI coding agents like Cursor and Claude Code via MCP, or functions as a CLI tool. Features include auto-learning usage patterns, batch retrieval, multi-framework exports (React/Vue/Svelte), and direct SVG output to save tokens in AI chats.
